short_description: Granada HRES high-resolution library, 3000-7000 A only (SVO hres)
description: SVO's Granada HRES library (Martins et al. 2005): high-resolution synthetic spectra covering only about 3000-7000 Angstrom, too little wavelength for broadband photometry on its own.

sources.name: SVO Theory Server
sources.title: Granada HRES Library
sources.retrieved: SVO download dated 2025-01-29 (file times of the 1,650 raw files in cirrus /media/data3/MESA/data/stellar_models/hres)
sources.copy: SVO's ASCII spectra as downloaded, standardized on 6 Nov 2026 by SED_Tools' clean_model_dir: the header is rewritten and the units kept (Angstrom, erg/cm2/s/A, no conversion, no flux rescaled); lookup, flux cube and h5 built by SED_Tools

completeness.upstream_count_from: SVO's FID list for hres as SED_Tools cached it

terms.for: the SVO Theory Server, the copy NJM holds
